 Expo Al Dhaid to launch 'Adventure and Camping 8' Oct 28
 October 23, 2026 / 7:52 PM 
 Share 
 Sharjah24: Expo Centre Al Dhaid will host the eighth edition of the Adventure and Camping Exhibition from October 28 to November 1, featuring the participation of over 200 companies and brands specializing in the adventure, camping, and vehicle outfitting sectors.
 The exhibition brings together a wide range of products tailored to the needs of outdoor enthusiasts—from camping gear and expedition supplies to off-road vehicles, accessories, and vehicle-outfitting solutions—allowing visitors to explore the latest offerings from specialized companies. 
 Abdullah Sultan Al Owais, Chairman of the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and Chairman of Expo Centre Sharjah, stated that specialized exhibitions stimulate commercial activity, create engagement between businesses and the public, and open gates to new opportunities for brands to expand.
